buildCommand: pwd && echo 'Contents:' && ls -la && VERCEL_FILE=$(find . -maxdepth 3 -name 'vercel.json' -type f 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -n "$VERCEL_FILE" ]; then cd "$(dirname "$VERCEL_FILE")" && echo 'After cd, pwd:' && pwd && echo 'Contents after cd:' && ls -la; fi && if [ -d backend ]; then (cd backend && npm install && npm run build); else echo 'ERROR: backend directory not found!' && exit 1; fi && if [ -d frontend ]; then (cd frontend && npm install && npm run build); else echo 'ERROR: frontend directory not found!' && exit 1; fi
